# What's the new car loan interest deduction worth?

> Free calculator for the new federal auto loan interest deduction (One Big Beautiful Bill Act, tax years 2025-2028): applies the $10,000 cap, the $200-per-$1,000 MAGI phase-out, and the 8-item new/US-assembled/personal-use/first-lien eligibility checklist -- including the MFS treatment most people get wrong.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## What it answers

A new federal deduction applies to tax years 2025 through 2028: up to $10,000/year of interest paid on a loan for a new, US-assembled, personal-use vehicle — but only if eight eligibility conditions are all met, and it shrinks once your income clears $100,000 (single/HoH/MFS) or $200,000 (joint). This checks every condition and estimates the deduction, including the married-filing-separately rule most people assume works the opposite way it actually does. Source: 26 U.S.C. section 163(h)(4) as added by Public Law 119-21 (2025), and Treasury's proposed regulations of 2026-01-02. As of 2026-09-24.
